rules.statement: In an appeal from a decision of the District Court in a testamentary proceeding, the proper stamps for the decree of the Supreme Court must be delivered together with the petition of appeal to the Secretary of the District Court as required by Part II, Head F-Miscellaneous of Schedule A to the Stamp Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: We are of the opinion that even in an appeal from a decision of the District Court in a testamentary proceeding the proper stamps for the decree of the Supreme Court must be delivered together with the petition of appeal to the Secretary of the District Court as required by Part II F-Miscellaneous of Schedule A to the Stamp Ordinance. Failure to do so is fatal to the reception of an appeal.
